title: Run the sweep in the VM lab, not Parallels or the real phone
context: The Parallels macOS VM used by earlier sweeps was removed (~/Parallels was empty at 13:34 on 2026-09-30), and a VM lab (`lab` command, vm-lab skill, ~/VMLab) appeared with disposable macOS VMs and Android emulators reset from clean goldens. Criterion 10.17 names the Note10+ for speed.
options: Lab for journeys, and the Note10+ for the speed bench and a smoke test
Lab for the Mac, and the Note10+ for all Android journeys and the bench
outcome: The owner, in their own words: "Parallels VM will no longer be used for sandbox testing. Rely upon the `VMLab` skill to use the new sandbox environment to test both macOS and Android changes fully without needing a real device. Defer testing on a real phone for afterwards ONLY if necessary and recommended."U+000AU+000ASo macOS journeys run in a lab macOS VM (`macos-1`) and Android journeys in the lab `android-phone` emulator. Speed is judged by before/after runs in the same lab instance: the baseline bench is f552f46 built with Flutter 3.47.5 from `testkit/work/meadow-bench`. A phone run is proposed afterwards only if the lab leaves 10.17 undecided.
